description:
-Impeccably Presented 4 Bedroom Detached Family Home

-Separate Converted Garage Offering Possible 5th Bedroom With Ensuite & Kitchen (Subject To PP)

-A Short Walk To Enniscorthy Town Centre

-Upgraded and New Roof Installed In 2024 

-Wonderful Mature Gardens With South Facing Raised Patio Deck

-Light, Bright & Convenient to All Amenities


Premium Collection is delighted to bring to the market this impeccably presented 4 bedroom detached family home just a few minutes walk from the heart of Enniscorthy town centre. 

The main house is accessed through a glass panelled front door into a light and bright hallway. To the right off the hall is a cozy living room with feature fireplace and to the left is a spacious kitchen/dining room complete with ample shaker style cabinetry and quality integrated appliances. Two large solid wood sliding barn style doors invites you into a large spacious conservatory which is filled with light and is perfect for entertainment and/or relaxation. The downstairs is completed by a large bathroom with spacious walk-in shower with bespoke bathroom pieces and floor to ceiling tile.

Upstairs comprises 4 spacious bedrooms accessed from a dual level central landing. There are fitted wardrobes in the master and second bedroom with scope to add the same in the other two bedrooms.

In a separate adjacent building is a recently renovated 243 sqft garage which offers the possibility (subject to planning permission) of a self contained living space with shower room en-suite and complete with a fully fitted kitchen. The vaulted ceiling gives a wonderful sense of spaciousness while offering a cozy and warm ambiance and would be ideal for guests, a live-in relative or could just be part of the overall accommodation for the family.

Outside is a delightful and impeccably presented garden with manicured bushes, a lawn with bedding for numerous rose bushes and front patio. To the rear is a raised patio deck with a southerly aspect which is an ideal entertainment space.

There is also ample private and secure parking with a brick paved driveway behind wrought iron gates together with a victorian lampost providing extra lighting at night. Extensively upgraded in 2024 together with a new roof in the main house, the specification in this home is exemplary with triple glazed windows, laminate wood and tile flooring and choice hardware throughout. 

With the M11 only a few minutes away and being a short distance from Enniscorthy town centre there is convenient access to almost every amenity. Whether it be a short drive to the beach or wooded hiking trails or cycling the many routes in the sunny southeast or hopping on the train for a days shopping in Dublin, this home offers the best of all lifestyles.
